name: How each path would come back
what: A classifier that ships with Silo says what would bring each path back if it vanished: a pull, a rebuild, or nothing, which is "only here". A path it cannot place counts as "only here", and each path also gets a coarse kind, such as code, build output, cache or credential-like. To say so, it may read inside the computer, such as the state of a Git repository.
